sites.name: Santa Ana College - Fainbarg Chase Thrive Center
sites.address: 2900 W Edinger Ave, Santa Ana, CA 92704
sites.note: Primary source (SAC SCE food-support page) confirms the Fainbarg Chase Thrive Center food pantry at Village-206, 2900 W Edinger Ave, Santa Ana CA 92704, phone (714) 564-6458, and that it is active for 2025-2026 (Spring 2026 programs listed). Specific food-pantry shopping hours are NOT reliably published: the Thrive Center office hours are Mon-Thu 8:00-17:00 / Fri 8:00-12:00, but these differ from pantry shopping hours (various unconfirmed snippets gave Mon-Thu 10:00-12:00 & 13:00-18:00, Fri 10:00-12:00). Pantry serves current SAC/SCE students only. Contact (714) 564-6458 / thrivecenter@sac.edu to confirm pantry hours. Note the main SAC campus is 1530 W 17th St 92706, but the SCE/Thrive food-support page lists the pantry at 2900 W Edinger Ave.
